title: Add minimal RAG microfrontend + serverless connector example
author: Anika Patel
description: Motivation: provide a small, copy-pasteable RAG example that demonstrates an end-to-end dev loop: a tiny React microfrontend that streams tokens from Redwood hosted inference, a lightweight serverless connector (AWS Lambda) that proxies the embedding + retrieval flow, and a local dev harness for iteration. This PR adds a new quickstart 'rag-microfrontend' aimed at frontend + platform engineers who want a simple integration with streaming responses and tool-calling patterns. What is included: a README with architecture diagrams and how to run locally; a React client (TypeScript, Vite) demonstrating streaming UI, partial-token rendering, and request batching recommendations; a Node.js Lambda handler that performs embeddings lookup against a sample SQLite vector index and calls Redwood for completion; CI workflow for preview deployments (GitHub Actions: build + test + deploy-preview to a static hosting action); example env templates and a small script to seed the local vector DB. Design notes: prefer a small move-fast example over full infra—using SQLite for portability and a minimal vector similarity function so users can experiment without cloud infra. The client demonstrates best-practice prompt shaping, streaming error handling, and a safe fallback that switches to a cheaper compatible model when the primary model returns a capacity error. Checklist: - [x] Add example scaffold and README with quickstart steps - [x] Add streaming client implementation with partial rendering and reconnect logic - [x] Add Lambda connector and local seed script - [x] Add CI preview workflow and basic tests - [x] Documentation links to Redwood Console routing and Dedicated autoscaling docs Testing: local dev run + unit test for the similarity function + integration smoke test using the seeded DB. Backwards-compat notes: compatible with Redwood API surface; no breaking changes. Related: ENG-7281 tracks a future follow-up for an opinionated production deployment guide.
